candidates.title: Higher absolute voltage wins (symmetric)
candidates.reason: Visible: train-1 left 4.7139 vs right 4.492 -> left; train-2 left 4.3069 vs right 4.492 -> right; train-3 left 4.492 vs right 4.3069 -> left; question-1 left -4.5143 vs right 4.492 -> left. Testimony for question-1 (not independently verified): written labels 4.51 and 4.48, negative meter sign not used in published ordering. Inferred (not visible): creator ranks higher magnitude higher, ignoring sign. Raw higher-wins fails question-1, so replaced with absolute version. Exact tie not observed, so tie is underdetermined - abstain.

candidates.title: Left absolute bar only
candidates.reason: Visible: absolute left values train-1 4.7139 -> left, train-2 4.3069 -> right, train-3 4.492 -> left, question-1 4.5143 -> left; right value 4.492 occurs with both left and right outcomes so right alone does not separate. Testimony (not verified): negative sign not used. Inferred alternative (not visible): left magnitude bar only with illustrative 4.4 between observed 4.3069 and 4.492, not official guidance. Fits all four. Diverges from symmetric when both high but right higher absolute, or both low but left higher.

candidates.title: Left default unless right beats left absolute and is high
candidates.reason: Visible: same four left/right pairs and outcomes as above. Testimony (not verified): sign ignored. Inferred alternative (not visible): default left unless right both beats left in magnitude and clears illustrative 4.4, not official guidance. Fits all four: train-1 fails right>left absolute, train-2 meets both, train-3 fails right>left, question-1 fails right>left absolute (4.492 vs 4.5143). Predicts left when right beats left absolute but both low, unlike symmetric.

candidates.title: Very high left absolute dominates, otherwise absolute higher wins
candidates.reason: Visible: train-1 left 4.7139 is unique high; others use only magnitudes 4.3069, 4.492, 4.5143. Testimony (not verified): sign ignored. Inferred alternative (not visible): very high left magnitude wins outright with illustrative >=4.7 between observed 4.5143 and 4.7139, not official guidance, otherwise higher absolute wins. Fits all four. Predicts left even if right higher absolute when left is very high, unlike symmetric.

markdown:
# USB cable comparison · published-video pilot

Status: DEMONSTRATION ONLY

Task: Capture a reviewable guide to predicting which of two tested cables the creator ranks higher.

Scope: One published video by pileofstuff (CC BY), one resistive test setup. Values are prior Meta observations; preference labels are assistant transcriptions of published ordering, not independently expert-verified. Not electrical compliance or real business validation.

Reviewer: Coding assistant — demonstration reviewer, not an electronics expert

Review note: Development pilot on published cable comparisons only. Candidate selected using general electrical knowledge, not an expert attestation. Reference preferences were transcribed by the coding assistant and these cases were used in earlier development. No manufacturer compliance, new-device generalization, real business adoption or ROI is established. Missing evidence and ties must abstain.

Self-attestation only; identity, expertise, operating safety and compliance are not verified.



## Decision guide

1. If magnitude of Left cable voltage (V) is greater than magnitude of Right cable voltage (V): **left**.

2. If magnitude of Right cable voltage (V) is greater than magnitude of Left cable voltage (V): **right**.

Otherwise: Ask the expert; no prediction.

Unknown or incomparable evidence: ask the expert.



## Evidence and limitations

Training cases: train-1, train-2, train-3, question-1

Model proposal: Visible: train-1 left 4.7139 vs right 4.492 -> left; train-2 left 4.3069 vs right 4.492 -> right; train-3 left 4.492 vs right 4.3069 -> left; question-1 left -4.5143 vs right 4.492 -> left. Testimony for question-1 (not independently verified): written labels 4.51 and 4.48, negative meter sign not used in published ordering. Inferred (not visible): creator ranks higher magnitude higher, ignoring sign. Raw higher-wins fails question-1, so replaced with absolute version. Exact tie not observed, so tie is underdetermined - abstain.

Guide version: 5db9c683-1665-4f9c-8c9a-263ffb50017d

Fingerprint: 25d337b13055ccf9b5f07c68626b25fd6ebb8307680daa795a518f5c5e0fe563

This captures reviewed practice for the stated scope; it is not manufacturer authorization or a compliance finding.
